ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
In the experiment “measuring the volt-ampere characteristic of a light bulb,” there are four erroneous circuits in the circuit connected by the students, as shown in the figure. The internal resistance of the power supply is not counted, and the wires are well connected. If the contact of the sliding rheostat is placed at the left end, S is closed, and during the process in which the contact slides toward the right end, the following four phenomena will respectively occur: a. Light bulb L does not light; the ammeter reading is almost zero
b. The brightness of light bulb L increases; the ammeter reading increases
c. Light bulb L does not light at first, and later suddenly emits light; the ammeter goes from having a nonzero reading to the coil being burned out
d. Light bulb L does not light; the ammeter reading increases until the coil is burned out
The circuit numbers corresponding to the above four phenomena a, b, c, and d are (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are four numbered circuits in the figure. In ①, light bulb L is connected between the left-side bus and the slider of the sliding rheostat, equivalent to being connected in parallel with the left section of the sliding rheostat; ammeter A is in the right-side main circuit, and voltmeter V is connected between the left and right buses. In ②, the sliding rheostat is connected in series before the power supply and the right-side parallel part; the right-side light bulb L, voltmeter V, and ammeter A are connected in parallel between the same pair of nodes. In ③, light bulb L and ammeter A are connected in parallel above, but the right end of this parallel part must pass through voltmeter V before connecting to the slider of the sliding rheostat. In ④, ammeter A is directly connected between the left-side bus and the slider of the sliding rheostat; the branch of light bulb L is also connected in series with voltmeter V. Reasoning: According to the ideal-meter approximation, the internal resistance of the ammeter is very small, and the internal resistance of the voltmeter is very large. In ①, when the slider moves from the left end to the right, the voltage across the light bulb gradually increases from nearly zero, the brightness of the light bulb increases, and the main-circuit current also increases, corresponding to phenomenon b. In ②, the ammeter is connected in parallel with the light bulb, and the low-resistance ammeter almost short-circuits the light bulb, so at first the light bulb does not light but the ammeter has a reading; moving the slider right makes the series resistance decrease, and the ammeter current increases until it burns out. After it burns out, the short circuit is removed, and the light bulb suddenly emits light, corresponding to phenomenon c. In ③, the part where the light bulb and ammeter are located must be connected to the slider through the high-resistance voltmeter, approximately an open circuit, so the light bulb does not light, and the ammeter reading is almost zero, corresponding to phenomenon a. In ④, the low-resistance branch of the ammeter is directly connected between the left bus and the slider. When the slider moves right, the current in the ammeter branch increases until the coil burns out; the light bulb branch is connected in series with the high-resistance voltmeter, and the light bulb still does not light, corresponding to phenomenon d. Therefore, in the order of a, b, c, d, they are ③, ①, ②, ④.

method.method_draft: 先从图中逐个读出四个错误电路的连接方式，再用理想电表和滑动变阻器的等效关系判断现象：①中灯泡 L 接在滑动变阻器左端与滑片之间，即与变阻器左段并联，电流表在主路中，电压表跨接电源两端；滑片从左向右移时，灯泡两端电压从近零增大，主路电流增大，对应 b。②中灯泡、伏特表、电流表并联在同一对节点上，且这一并联组前面串有滑动变阻器；电流表低阻几乎短路灯泡，开始灯泡不亮但电流表有示数，滑片右移使串联电阻减小，电流表电流增大至烧断，烧断后短路解除灯泡忽然发光，对应 c。③中灯泡和电流表所在并联部分要通过伏特表与滑片相连，伏特表高阻近似断路，故灯泡不亮，电流表几乎无示数，对应 a。④中电流表直接接在左母线和滑片之间，灯泡支路还串有伏特表高阻；滑片右移时电流表支路电流增大直至烧断，而灯泡仍不亮，对应 d。最后按 a、b、c、d 排列得到③①②④。

推理：按理想电表近似，电流表内阻很小，电压表内阻很大。①中滑片从左端向右移动时，灯泡两端电压由接近零逐渐增大，灯泡亮度增加，主路电流也增大，对应现象 b。②中电流表与灯泡并联，低阻电流表几乎把灯泡短路，所以开始灯泡不亮但电流表有示数；滑片右移使串联电阻减小，电流表电流增大直到烧断，烧断后短路解除，灯泡忽然发光，对应现象 c。③中灯泡和电流表所在部分要通过高阻电压表与滑片相连，近似断路，所以灯泡不亮，电流表示数几乎为零，对应现象 a。④中电流表低阻支路直接接在左母线和滑片之间，滑片右移时电流表支路电流增大直至线圈烧断；灯泡支路串有高阻电压表，灯泡仍不亮，对应现象 d。因此按 a、b、c、d 的顺序为③、①、②、④。

In ④, ammeter A is directly connected between the left-side bus and the slider of the sliding rheostat; the branch of light bulb L is also connected in series with voltmeter V.
Reasoning: According to the ideal-meter approximation, the internal resistance of the ammeter is very small, and the internal resistance of the voltmeter is very large. In ①, when the slider moves from the left end to the right, the voltage across the light bulb gradually increases from nearly zero, the brightness of the light bulb increases, and the main-circuit current also increases, corresponding to phenomenon b. In ②, the ammeter is connected in parallel with the light bulb, and the low-resistance ammeter almost short-circuits the light bulb, so at first the light bulb does not light but the ammeter has a reading; moving the slider right makes the series resistance decrease, and the ammeter current increases until it burns out. After it burns out, the short circuit is removed, and the light bulb suddenly emits light, corresponding to phenomenon c. In ③, the part where the light bulb and ammeter are located must be connected to the slider through the high-resistance voltmeter, approximately an open circuit, so the light bulb does not light, and the ammeter reading is almost zero, corresponding to phenomenon a. In ④, the low-resistance branch of the ammeter is directly connected between the left bus and the slider. When the slider moves right, the current in the ammeter branch increases until the coil burns out; the light bulb branch is connected in series with the high-resistance voltmeter, and the light bulb still does not light, corresponding to phenomenon d. Therefore, in the order of a, b, c, d, they are ③, ①, ②, ④.
